thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> INC-5076 triggered: canary /v1/generate 5xx spike (threshold: >5% in 2m). Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-5076
Maria L: acked. I'm oncall — starting triage. Canary rollout 2026-03-12 02:00UTC.
Raj P: seeing 502/503s coming from canary-03 (us-west-2). Pods are restarting ~1/2m. grep of recent logs shows tokenizer error: `ErrTokenize: invalid sequence` repeated.
Sam G: CI/merge from last night included the quant-kernel change. InfraBot reported a green CI but with a flag `ENABLE_TOKEN_CACHE=true` set by accident in canary image. Could be cache eviction + kernel change.
Katia M: any customer impact yet? Are sessions failing or silently degraded?
Maria L: quick check -> org-phi and org-theta show elevated 5xx. Traffic fraction to canary ~7% - estimate ~0.6% of global requests failing, but for org-phi it's closer to 3%. Noting SLO error budget burn risk.
Raj P: grabbing logs and core dumps now. snippet: ```[02:03:12Z] ERROR tokenizer: cannot decode seq id=0x7f3a 
 stack: runtime: panic: token cache boundary violation -> eviction race at idx 1024
```
Sam G: starting rollback to rev-20260311-9f (previous stable) for canary. Plan: scale canary down to 0 traffic, deploy stable image, reintroduce traffic gradually. Will post commands.
Maria L: go for rollback. Notify PD customers that may have seen errors. Katia, can you draft an external blurb?
Katia M: yep. Short note: "We're investigating a service degradation affecting a small subset of requests to the Text Generation API caused by a recent canary change. Engineers are rolling back the canary; we expect normal traffic within ~10 minutes. We'll update when rotation completes." Want to append anything?
Raj P: executing rollback now. Commands: ```kubectl set image deploy/canary canary=rev-20260311-9f -n prod && kubectl rollout status deploy/canary -n prod -w``` Doing image swap.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-5076: Maria L acknowledged at 02:06 UTC. Escalation muted.
Sam G: rollout completed on canary. Healthchecks returning green. P95 latency back to baseline.
Maria L: monitoring metrics — 5xx rate dropping. Org-phi/sampling shows failed rate fallen to ~0.03%.
Raj P: root cause summary for postmortem: quant-kernel patch + ENABLE_TOKEN_CACHE true exposed a race in shared tokenizer cache leading to eviction/invalid sequence under certain request batching patterns. Repro on canary with synthetic load.
Sam G: immediate next actions: 1) revert kernel change from edge branch, 2) flip off ENABLE_TOKEN_CACHE in next canary image by default, 3) add a cache safety check to prevent eviction races. I'll open PRs and link.
Maria L: good. Assigning follow-ups: Sam -> rollback PR + toggled flag, Raj -> instrumentation + add assertion to tokenizer, Katia -> customer comms update + incident postmortem draft. I'll keep this thread for handoff to next oncall.
Katia M: posting update to status page and pinging affected accounts. Quick note in support channel. :white_check_mark:
Maria L: handing off to Raj for overnight watch and postmortem. Adding runbook link: https://redwood-infra/runbooks/canary-rollout-issues. Please escalate to SRE Lead if 5xx >0.5% for 10m.
Raj P: acked, taking over. Leaving breadcrumbs in the incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident INC-5076 resolved (auto) -> marked resolved by Maria L at 02:14 UTC.
Maria L: closing thread here, will publish postmortem draft in ~2 hours. Thanks all. :pray:
